questions.question: What should I prepare before coming to record?
questions.answer: You should memorize the lyrics, prepare the beat (high-quality WAV file recommended) and send it to 2LAB, or contact us for further assistance. A good night's sleep and drinking enough water also help your voice perform at its best.

questions.question: How long does it take to complete the Mix & Master?
questions.answer: Normally, the Mix & Master process will take 3-5 working days depending on the complexity of the song. We always prioritize product quality.

questions.question: Do you offer online mixing services?
questions.answer: Yes, we provide professional online mixing services nationwide and internationally. Just send your stems via our cloud system and we'll send back the final master within 3-5 days.

questions.question: What file formats do you accept?
questions.answer: We accept all standard audio formats including WAV, MP3, FLAC, etc. We highly recommend WAV for the best quality. Contact 2LAB for specific requirements.
